The resignation assumes significance as Hasina has announced that she would return to Bangladesh in December. In November 2025, a Bangladeshi court sentenced Hasina to death in absentia for her role in a violent crackdown on protesters that led to her ouster. Shahabuddin, who remained in office after Hasina fled to India in August 2024, oversaw a transition that first saw a caretaker administration led by Nobel laureate Mohammad Yunus. Elections held this past February propelled Bangladesh National Party’s Tarique Rahman to power.

full_text: Retail spending fell in March as consumers pull back Spending at US retailers fell in March as consumers pulled back amid recessionary fears fueled by the banking crisis. Spending at US retailers fell in March as consumers pulled back after the banking crisis fueled recession fears. Retail sales, which are adjusted for seasonality but not for inflation, fell by 1% in March from the prior month, the Commerce Department reported on Friday. That was steeper than an expected 0.4% decline, according to Refinitiv, and above the revised 0.2% decline in the prior month. Investors chalk up some of the weakness to a lack of tax returns and concerns about a slowing labor market.
